hints.title: State Aggregation
hints.text: Group records by the state column.

hints.title: String Aggregation
hints.text: Combine city names into a comma-separated list ordered alphabetically using GROUP_CONCAT or STRING_AGG.

hints.title: Alphabetical Ordering
hints.text: Order the final result table alphabetically by state name.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT 
    state, 
    GROUP_CONCAT(city ORDER BY city ASC SEPARATOR ', ') AS cities
FROM cities
GROUP BY state
ORDER BY state ASC;
```

complexity.notes: Grouping and sorting city names takes O(n log n).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Not applicable; single aggregation query is optimal.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary memory for concatenated output.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use group concatenation functions with internal sorting.

solutions.code:
SELECT 
    state, 
    GROUP_CONCAT(city ORDER BY city ASC SEPARATOR ', ') AS cities
FROM cities
GROUP BY state
ORDER BY state ASC;

SELECT 
    state, 
    STRING_AGG(city, ', ' ORDER BY city ASC) AS cities
FROM cities
GROUP BY state
ORDER BY state ASC;
